newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR FINISHES MIXED ON TUESDAY.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR FINISHES MIXED ON TUESDAY.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar closed mixed against hard currencies after Tuesday's fairly active interbank trading session, dealers said.
"We saw the dollar moving up and down during the day. I suspect there was a payment in the market," one dealer said.
He added that the local unit reached a low of 11.3000/3100 against the U.S. dollar, prompting the central Reserve Bank to intervene.
"The RBZ came in with support for the dollar at the 11.3000 level and we saw it going up a bit," the dealer said.
The Zimbabwe dollar finished the day at 11.2950/3050 against the U.S. dollar from 11.2800/2900 on Monday.

Against the crosses, it weakened to 18.3800/4000 from 18.3600/3800 on sterling but was quoted firmer versus the mark at 6.5200/5400 compared to 6.5500/5700. Against the rand it held steady at 2.5300/5400.
